source.name: Project Hoomans Scene Runtime Adopter Content

translations.EN: That's a horde. We fighting through or pulling back?
translations.TL: Kawan iyan. Lalaban ba tayo o uurong?

translations.EN: Look at that crowd. Do we stand our ground or run?
translations.TL: Tingnan mo ang dami nila. Maninindigan ba tayo o tatakbo?

translations.EN: Huge pack ahead. What's the call: fight or retreat?
translations.TL: Malaking kawan sa unahan. Anong pasya: lalaban o aatras?

translations.EN: That is a serious horde. Do we engage or bypass?
translations.TL: Matinding kawan 'yan. Lalabanan ba natin o iiwasan?

translations.EN: They're swarming. Are we cutting through or falling back?
translations.TL: Dumudumog sila. Babasagin ba natin o aatras tayo?

translations.EN: Too many bodies out there. What do you want to do?
translations.TL: Napakaraming patay sa labas. Ano ang gusto mong gawin?

translations.EN: Horde spotted. We taking them on or finding another route?
translations.TL: May kawan sa unahan. Lalabanan ba natin o maghahanap ng ibang daan?

translations.EN: Massive group approaching. Engage or evacuate?
translations.TL: Napakalaking grupo ang papalapit. Lalaban o lilikas?

translations.EN: That's a swarm. Give the order: fight or retreat?
translations.TL: Kawan 'yan. Mag-utos ka: laban o urong?

translations.EN: Look at that numbers disadvantage. Stand or withdraw?
translations.TL: Tingnan mo ang dami nila laban sa atin. Tatayo o aatras?

translations.EN: That's a lot of them. Stay close—fight or fall back?
translations.TL: Ang dami nila. Dumikit ka—lalaban o uurong?

translations.EN: Too many for comfort, friend. What's your gut say: fight or run?
translations.TL: Masyadong marami para maging panatag, kaibigan. Anong kutob mo: laban o takbo?

translations.EN: Stay right next to me. Do we take them together or get out?
translations.TL: Manatili ka sa tabi ko. Sabay ba nating lalabanan o aalis tayo?

translations.EN: That swarm is dangerous. I want us alive—fight or retreat?
translations.TL: Delikado ang kawang 'yan. Gusto kong mabuhay tayo—laban o urong?

translations.EN: I'm with you whatever you decide. Are we pushing through or retreating?
translations.TL: Kasama mo ako kahit anong desisyon mo. Susulong ba tayo o aatras?

translations.EN: Careful, partner. That's a massive pack. Call the play.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat, kasama. Malaking kawan 'yan. Sabihin mo ang plano.

translations.EN: Look out, friend! Do we clear them or save our strength and run?
translations.TL: Mag-ingat, kaibigan! Uubusin ba natin sila o magtitipid ng lakas at tatakbo?

translations.EN: They're everywhere. Stick by me—fight or fall back?
translations.TL: Nasa lahat sila ng sulok. Dumikit ka—laban o urong?

translations.EN: I trust your call. Are we taking this swarm on or heading back?
translations.TL: Tiwala ako sa pasya mo. Lalabanan ba natin ang kawang ito o babalik?

translations.EN: Big herd ahead. Don't worry, we're a team. What's the plan?
translations.TL: Malaking kawan sa unahan. Huwag kang mag-alala, magkasama tayo. Anong plano?

translations.EN: Horde. Fight or fall back?
translations.TL: Kawan. Laban o urong?

translations.EN: Too many. Call it: stand or run?
translations.TL: Sobra sila. Magpasya: tayo o takbo?

translations.EN: Swarm ahead. Fight or retreat?
translations.TL: Kawan sa unahan. Laban o urong?

translations.EN: Herd. What's the call?
translations.TL: Kawan. Anong desisyon?

translations.EN: Massive group. Push or pull?
translations.TL: Malaking grupo. Sulong o urong?

translations.EN: Numbers are bad. Engage?
translations.TL: Masama ang bilang. Lalaban?

translations.EN: Horde spotted. Decision now.
translations.TL: Kawan nakita. Desisyon ngayon na.

translations.EN: Dozens of them. Stand or flee?
translations.TL: Dose-dosena sila. Lalaban o tatakas?

translations.EN: Swarm incoming. Your call.
translations.TL: Kawan parating. Pasya mo.

translations.EN: Crowd ahead. Fight or back off?
translations.TL: Grupo sa harap. Laban o atras?

translations.EN: Big group ahead. We decide now: engage or avoid.
translations.TL: Malaking grupo sa harap. Magpasya tayo ngayon: lumaban o umiwas.

translations.EN: That horde will tear us apart if we hesitate. What's the move?
translations.TL: Lalapain tayo ng kawang 'yan kapag nag-atubili tayo. Anong galaw?

translations.EN: Bad odds. We fight with discipline or we slip away right now.
translations.TL: Masamang tsansa. Lumaban nang may disiplina o tumakas agad ngayon.

translations.EN: I'm not dying here. Decide: cut through or fall back?
translations.TL: Di ako mamamatay dito. Magpasya ka: basagin o umatras?

translations.EN: Check the numbers. Engage only if we have choke points.
translations.TL: Tingnan mo ang dami. Lumaban lang kung may masisikipang daan.

translations.EN: Horde is closing in. Make a choice before they surround us.
translations.TL: Palapit na ang kawan. Pumili bago nila tayo mapaligiran.

translations.EN: We can't afford mistakes against that herd. Stand or withdraw?
translations.TL: Di tayo pwede magkamali sa kawang 'yan. Lalaban o aatras?

translations.EN: Watch the flanks. Do we fight or get the hell out?
translations.TL: Bantayan ang tagiliran. Lalaban ba tayo o aalis na agad?

translations.EN: They'll overwhelm an open position. Call it now.
translations.TL: Tatalunin nila tayo sa bukas na lugar. Magpasya ka na.

translations.EN: Huge pack. If we fight, nobody breaks formation.
translations.TL: Malaking kawan. Kung lalaban, walang sisira sa pormasyon.

translations.EN: We can take them.
translations.TL: Kaya natin sila.

translations.EN: We've handled worse. Let's clear them.
translations.TL: Nakalusot na tayo sa mas malala. Ubusin natin sila.

translations.EN: Stand firm. We fight through.
translations.TL: Tumayo nang matatag. Lalabanan natin sila.

translations.EN: We have the weapons. Let's put them down.
translations.TL: Nasa atin ang armas. Patumbahin natin sila.

translations.EN: Ready up. We're not running from this.
translations.TL: Humanda ka. Hindi natin tatakbuhan ito.

translations.EN: We take the fight to them. Stay sharp.
translations.TL: Sasalubungin natin sila. Maging alerto.

translations.EN: Line them up. We can win this.
translations.TL: Pilahin sila. Kayang-kaya natin ito.

translations.EN: No backing down. We push through.
translations.TL: Walang atrasan. Babasagin natin 'to.

translations.EN: We hold here and eliminate the threat.
translations.TL: Dito tayo tatayo at aalisin ang banta.

translations.EN: I'm ready. Let's make every strike count.
translations.TL: Handa na ako. Tiyaking may tama ang bawat palo.

translations.EN: I'm with you. We can take them.
translations.TL: Kasama mo ako. Kaya natin sila.

translations.EN: Together, nothing can stop us! Let's do this.
translations.TL: Kapag magkasama tayo, walang makapipigil sa atin! Tara na.

translations.EN: I've got your back, friend. We fight as one.
translations.TL: Hawak ko ang likod mo, kaibigan. Iisang laban tayo.

translations.EN: We survive together, we fight together. Let's clear them out!
translations.TL: Sabay tayong nabubuhay, sabay tayong lalaban. Ubusin natin sila!

translations.EN: With you beside me, I'm not afraid. Let's take them down.
translations.TL: Dahil katabi kita, hindi ako natatakot. Patumbahin natin sila.

translations.EN: Let's show them what real survivors are made of!
translations.TL: Ipakita natin sa kanila kung ano ang tunay na nakaligtas!

translations.EN: Right by your side, partner. We won't lose today.
translations.TL: Nasa tabi mo lang ako, kasama. Hindi tayo matatalo ngayon.

translations.EN: I trust us. Let's stand tall and fight.
translations.TL: Tiwala ako sa atin. Tumindig tayo at lumaban.

translations.EN: We've got this, friend. Watch my back and I'll watch yours.
translations.TL: Kayang-kaya natin, kaibigan. Bantayan ang isa't isa.

translations.EN: Stay close and hit hard! We'll celebrate after.
translations.TL: Manatiling dikit at humampas nang malakas! Magdiriwang tayo mamaya.

translations.EN: Stand and fight.
translations.TL: Tumayo at lumaban.

translations.EN: We take them.
translations.TL: Kaya natin sila.

translations.EN: No retreat.
translations.TL: Walang urungan.

translations.EN: Draw weapons.
translations.TL: Bunot ng armas.

translations.EN: Kill them all.
translations.TL: Ubusin sila.

translations.EN: Fight through.
translations.TL: Lumaban pasulong.

translations.EN: Ready.
translations.TL: Handa.

translations.EN: Holding ground.
translations.TL: Hawak ang pwesto.

translations.EN: Let's do this.
translations.TL: Gawin na natin.

translations.EN: Bring them on.
translations.TL: Ilabas sila.

translations.EN: If we commit, we hit hard and stay together.
translations.TL: Kung lalaban tayo, sabay at todo ang tira.

translations.EN: No heroics. Funnel them into a choke point and execute.
translations.TL: Walang magpapakabayani. Ipitin sila sa sikip at tapusin.

translations.EN: Watch your stamina. Don't swing wild and get exhausted.
translations.TL: Bantayan ang lakas. Huwag magwala para di kapusin ng hangin.

translations.EN: Keep the line tight. If one falls, we both die.
translations.TL: Higpitan ang pormasyon. Kapag may bumagsak, patay tayong dalawa.

translations.EN: Target the leaders first. Clear them systematically.
translations.TL: Unahin ang mga nasa harap. Ubusin nang may sistema.

translations.EN: We fight, but maintain an escape route behind us.
translations.TL: Lalaban tayo, pero tiyaking may takasan sa likod natin.

translations.EN: Every strike must be lethal. No wasted energy.
translations.TL: Bawat tama dapat nakamamatay. Walang sayang na lakas.

translations.EN: Don't let them surround us. Push when I push.
translations.TL: Huwag magpapaligid sa kanila. Sumulong kapag sumulong ako.

translations.EN: We can win this if we keep cool heads and steady hands.
translations.TL: Mananalo tayo kung mananatiling malamig ang ulo at matatag ang kamay.

translations.EN: Agreed. Take out the front rank and hold the doorway.
translations.TL: Sang-ayon. Patumbahin ang unahan at hawakan ang pinto.

translations.EN: Too many. We should pull back.
translations.TL: Sobra sila. Dapat umatras tayo.

translations.EN: The odds are terrible. Let's retreat and find another way.
translations.TL: Napakasama ng tsansa. Umatras tayo at maghanap ng ibang daan.

translations.EN: Fighting here is a death sentence. Fall back.
translations.TL: Kamatayan ang lumaban dito. Umatras na.

translations.EN: We don't have the ammunition or stamina for this. Pull back.
translations.TL: Kulang tayo sa bala at lakas para rito. Umatras.

translations.EN: Better to live and fight another day. Let's withdraw.
translations.TL: Mas mabuting mabuhay para lumaban sa ibang araw. Umatras tayo.

translations.EN: We're completely outmatched. Retreat orderly.
translations.TL: Lupig tayo sa dami nila. Umatras nang maayos.

translations.EN: Back up slowly. Don't make sudden noises.
translations.TL: Umatras nang dahan-dahan. Huwag gumawa ng ingay.

translations.EN: Let's slip away while they haven't locked onto us.
translations.TL: Tumakas na tayo habang hindi pa sila nakapokus sa atin.

translations.EN: Too risky. We need to withdraw immediately.
translations.TL: Masyadong mapanganib. Kailangan nating umatras agad.

translations.EN: I agree with retreating. Turn around and move quietly.
translations.TL: Sang-ayon akong umatras. Lumingon at lumakad nang tahimik.

translations.EN: I'd rather get us out of this alive. Pull back.
translations.TL: Mas gusto kong makaalis tayong buhay. Umatras tayo.

translations.EN: I care too much about you to risk this. Let's retreat, friend.
translations.TL: Masyado kitang pinahahalagahan para isugal ito. Umatras tayo, kaibigan.

translations.EN: Please, let's fall back together. We don't have to die here.
translations.TL: Pakiusap, sabay tayong umatras. Di natin kailangang mamatay rito.

translations.EN: I need you alive, partner. Turn around, let's go.
translations.TL: Kailangan kitang buhay, kasama. Lumingon ka, tara na.

translations.EN: Let's save our strength for our people back home. Retreat.
translations.TL: Itabi natin ang lakas natin para sa kasama sa kampo. Umatras.

translations.EN: Take my hand if you need to, but we have to pull back now.
translations.TL: Hawakan mo ang kamay ko kung kailangan, pero aatras na tayo ngayon.

translations.EN: There's no shame in living to fight tomorrow. Fall back with me.
translations.TL: Walang kahihiyan sa pananatiling buhay. Umatras ka kasama ko.

translations.EN: Let's back away gently, together. I've got you.
translations.TL: Umatras tayo nang marahan, nang magkasama. Hawak kita.

translations.EN: We can find supplies elsewhere. Let's keep each other safe and run.
translations.TL: Makakahanap tayo ng gamit sa iba. Manatiling ligtas at tumakbo.

translations.EN: I'm not leaving without you, so let's both back up right now.
translations.TL: Di ako aalis nang wala ka, kaya umatras tayong pareho ngayon.

translations.EN: Pull back.
translations.TL: Umatras.

translations.EN: Too many. Run.
translations.TL: Sobra sila. Takbo.

translations.EN: Retreat.
translations.TL: Urong.

translations.EN: Fall back now.
translations.TL: Atras na ngayon.

translations.EN: Bad odds. Leave.
translations.TL: Masamang tsansa. Alis.

translations.EN: Out. Now.
translations.TL: Labas. Ngayon.

translations.EN: Back up.
translations.TL: Umatras.

translations.EN: Not here. Move.
translations.TL: Huwag dito. Kilos.

translations.EN: Escape.
translations.TL: Takas.

translations.EN: Away.
translations.TL: Malayo.

translations.EN: Bad odds. Give them space.
translations.TL: Masama ang tsansa. Lumayo tayo.

translations.EN: Fighting that pack is suicide. Withdraw in formation.
translations.TL: Pagpapakamatay ang labanang 'yan. Umatras nang may pormasyon.

translations.EN: Step back quietly. Do not alert the rear flank.
translations.TL: Umatras nang tahimik. Huwag gisingin ang nasa likod.

translations.EN: Keep your weapon raised, but reverse your footsteps.
translations.TL: Itaas ang armas, pero ihakbang pabalik ang paa.

translations.EN: We have zero tactical advantage. We fall back immediately.
translations.TL: Wala tayong kalamangan sa posisyon. Aatras tayo agad.

translations.EN: Don't let adrenaline make you stupid. We withdraw.
translations.TL: Huwag magpadala sa kaba at maging tanga. Aatras tayo.

translations.EN: Back away into the shadows. Let them wander past.
translations.TL: Umatras sa dilim. Hayaang lumampas sila.

translations.EN: I refuse to be butchered in an open field. Retreat.
translations.TL: Ayokong malapa sa bukas na damuhan. Umatras.

translations.EN: Keep low and retreat to the last secure building.
translations.TL: Yumuko at umatras sa huling ligtas na gusali.

translations.EN: Orderly withdrawal. If anyone runs screaming, they're dead.
translations.TL: Maayos na pag-atras. Kapag may nagpanic at sumigaw, patay 'yon.

translations.EN: Hold here. Don't rush it.
translations.TL: Dito muna. Huwag padalos-dalos.

translations.EN: Wait for them to thin out before making a move.
translations.TL: Hintaying mabawasan sila bago gumalaw.

translations.EN: Stay in position. Let's see which way they drift.
translations.TL: Manatili sa pwesto. Tingnan kung saan sila papunta.

translations.EN: Hold your ground and observe their path.
translations.TL: Hawakan ang pwesto at bantayan ang ruta nila.

translations.EN: No sudden movements. Let them pass if possible.
translations.TL: Walang biglaang galaw. Hayaang lumampas kung maaari.

translations.EN: Keep calm and hold the line right here.
translations.TL: Kumalma at hawakan ang linya dito.

translations.EN: Patience. Let's wait for the right opening.
translations.TL: Pasensya muna. Hintayin ang tamang puwang.

translations.EN: Hold steady. We decide when we have better information.
translations.TL: Maging matatag. Magpapasya tayo kapag mas marami nang impormasyon.

translations.EN: Don't panic. Hold position behind cover.
translations.TL: Huwag mag-panic. Manatili sa likod ng kublihan.

translations.EN: Steady now. Let's assess before we commit.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan lang. Timbangin muna bago sumugod.

translations.EN: Stay together. Let's hold before we commit.
translations.TL: Magkakasama tayo. Humawak muna bago sumugod.

translations.EN: Breathe easy, friend. We hold right here by each other.
translations.TL: Huminga ka nang maluwag, kaibigan. Hawak-kamay tayo rito.

translations.EN: I'm right beside you. Let's wait for a safe moment.
translations.TL: Nasa tabi mo lang ako. Hintayin natin ang ligtas na sandali.

translations.EN: Hold steady, partner. We don't have to rush into danger.
translations.TL: Magpakatatag ka, kasama. Di natin kailangang magpadalos-dalos.

translations.EN: Stay low with me. Let's watch their movements together.
translations.TL: Yumuko ka kasabay ko. Sabay nating bantayan ang galaw nila.

translations.EN: Keep calm. As long as we hold together, we'll be fine.
translations.TL: Manatiling kalmado. Hangga't magkasama tayo, magiging maayos tayo.

translations.EN: Just hold on for a minute. Let the worst of the herd pass.
translations.TL: Sandali lang. Hayaang lumampas ang pinakamalaking kawan.

translations.EN: Steady, friend. I'm right here with you in the quiet.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan, kaibigan. Narito lang ako kasama mo sa katahimikan.

translations.EN: Don't be scared. We hold this spot until we have a clean shot.
translations.TL: Huwag kang matakot. Hawakan ang pwesto hanggang may malinaw na daan.

translations.EN: Together and steady. Let's let them drift away.
translations.TL: Sama-sama at matatag. Hayaan natin silang lumayo.

translations.EN: Hold. Watch them.
translations.TL: Hawak. Bantayan sila.

translations.EN: Hold position.
translations.TL: Hawakan ang pwesto.

translations.EN: Wait.
translations.TL: Teka.

translations.EN: Stay low.
translations.TL: Yumuko.

translations.EN: Steady.
translations.TL: Magpakatatag.

translations.EN: Do not move.
translations.TL: Huwag gagalaw.

translations.EN: Hold.
translations.TL: Hawak.

translations.EN: Patience.
translations.TL: Pasensya.

translations.EN: Freeze.
translations.TL: Tigil.

translations.EN: Quiet. Watch.
translations.TL: Tahimik. Magmasid.

translations.EN: No rush. Hold position and watch the pressure.
translations.TL: Walang pagmamadali. Humawak at bantayan ang galaw nila.

translations.EN: Hold here. If you twitch, you draw the whole pack.
translations.TL: Dito muna. Kapag kumilos ka, mahahatak mo ang buong kawan.

translations.EN: Stay rooted. Wait until their lead walkers pass.
translations.TL: Manatiling nakatuntong. Hintaying lumampas ang nauuna.

translations.EN: Maintain silence and hold the corner.
translations.TL: Panatilihin ang katahimikan at hawakan ang kanto.

translations.EN: Do not engage prematurely. Let the herd scatter.
translations.TL: Huwag aatake nang maaga. Hayaang maghiwa-hiwalay ang kawan.

translations.EN: Hold your breath if you have to, but don't move.
translations.TL: Pigilin ang hininga kung kailangan, pero huwag gagalaw.

translations.EN: We wait for an exploitable mistake. Stay still.
translations.TL: Hintayin natin ang pagkakamali nila. Huwag gumalaw.

translations.EN: Keep your weapon ready, but do not fire yet. Hold.
translations.TL: Ihanda ang armas, pero huwag munang puputok. Hawak.

translations.EN: Hold tight against the wall. Let them walk past.
translations.TL: Dumikit sa pader. Hayaang maglakad sila palampas.

translations.EN: Steady. Any sound will turn this into a slaughterhouse.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan. Anumang ingay ay gagawin itong katayan.

translations.EN: I heard something worth passing on.
translations.TL: May narinig akong mahalagang ipasa sa iyo.

translations.EN: Got an update on what's happening nearby.
translations.TL: May balita ako sa mga nangyayari sa paligid.

translations.EN: There's fresh news from the neighboring zone.
translations.TL: May sariwang balita mula sa kalapit na lugar.

translations.EN: I picked up some information you should know about.
translations.TL: May nakuha akong impormasyon na dapat mong malaman.

translations.EN: Heads up: I heard a report about conditions outside.
translations.TL: Makinig ka: may narinig akong ulat tungkol sa kalagayan sa labas.

translations.EN: Passing along some intelligence I gathered.
translations.TL: Ipinapasa ko ang ilang impormasyong nakalap ko.

translations.EN: Here's what I've learned from other travelers.
translations.TL: Ito ang nalaman ko mula sa ibang manlalakbay.

translations.EN: You might want to hear this latest report.
translations.TL: Baka gusto mong marinig itong pinakahuling balita.

translations.EN: I have some verified information to share.
translations.TL: May napatunayan akong impormasyon na ibabahagi.

translations.EN: Listen to this news before you head out.
translations.TL: Pakinggan mo itong balita bago ka lumabas.

translations.EN: I thought you should hear what I learned.
translations.TL: Naisip kong dapat mong marinig ang nalaman ko.

translations.EN: Hey friend, I found out something that might help us.
translations.TL: Huy kaibigan, may nalaman akong makatutulong sa atin.

translations.EN: I wanted to make sure you were in the loop on this news.
translations.TL: Gusto kong tiyakin na may alam ka sa balitang ito.

translations.EN: Got some good intel to share with you, partner.
translations.TL: May magandang balita akong ibabahagi sa 'yo, kasama.

translations.EN: Always looking out for you—listen to what I heard.
translations.TL: Lagi kitang iniisip—makinig ka sa narinig ko.

translations.EN: Thought of you as soon as I heard this update.
translations.TL: Ikaw agad ang naisip ko nang marinig ko ang balitang ito.

translations.EN: Come here, I have news that might make things easier.
translations.TL: Halika rito, may balita ako na magpapagaan ng sitwasyon.

translations.EN: Happy to share this bit of hope with you today.
translations.TL: Masayang ibahagi ang kaunting pag-asang ito sa 'yo ngayon.

translations.EN: Listen up, friend. This could keep us safer.
translations.TL: Makinig ka, kaibigan. Mas makapagpapanatiling ligtas ito sa atin.

translations.EN: I wanted you to hear this first from me.
translations.TL: Gusto kong sa akin mo unang marinig ito.

translations.EN: Got some news for you.
translations.TL: May balita ako para sa iyo.

translations.EN: News.
translations.TL: Balita.

translations.EN: Listen up.
translations.TL: Makinig.

translations.EN: Heard something.
translations.TL: May narinig ako.

translations.EN: Intel for you.
translations.TL: Impormasyon para sa 'yo.

translations.EN: Update.
translations.TL: Ulat.

translations.EN: Here's the word.
translations.TL: Ito ang balita.

translations.EN: New report.
translations.TL: Bagong balita.

translations.EN: Check this.
translations.TL: Tingnan mo 'to.

translations.EN: Word from outside.
translations.TL: Balita mula sa labas.

translations.EN: I have something I can confirm.
translations.TL: May bagay akong makukumpirma.

translations.EN: I have verified intel, but keep it quiet.
translations.TL: May napatunayan akong impormasyon, pero panatilihing lihim.

translations.EN: Listen close. I don't want everyone overhearing this.
translations.TL: Makinig nang mabuti. Ayokong marinig ito ng lahat.

translations.EN: I'm sharing this with you because you need to know the risks.
translations.TL: Ibinabahagi ko ito dahil kailangan mong malaman ang panganib.

translations.EN: News from the perimeter. Don't go spreading it wildly.
translations.TL: Balita mula sa paligid. Huwag mong ikalat kung saan-saan.

translations.EN: I verified this rumor myself. Take it seriously.
translations.TL: Kinumpirma ko ang balitang ito mismo. Seryosohin mo.

translations.EN: Careful who you repeat this to, but here's the situation.

translations.TL: Pumalpak ang plano. Ititigil natin ang paglabas.

translations.EN: Call it off. Conditions are too hazardous.
translations.TL: Kanselahin na. Masyadong mapanganib ang kalagayan.

translations.EN: We're aborting the mission. Regroup back inside.
translations.TL: Ititigil ang misyon. Magtipon pabalik sa loob.

translations.EN: Trip canceled. Something compromised our route.
translations.TL: Kanselado ang biyahe. May sumira sa ruta natin.

translations.EN: Not happening today. Pull back to base.
translations.TL: Hindi matutuloy ngayon. Umatras pabalik sa base.

translations.EN: Mission failed. Better to abort than lose lives.
translations.TL: Bigo ang misyon. Mas mabuting ihinto kaysa may mamatay.

translations.EN: The run is scrubbed. Head back inside.
translations.TL: Kanselado ang paglabas. Bumalik sa loob.

translations.EN: Aborting the excursion. We'll rethink the plan.
translations.TL: Ititigil ang lakad. Pag-iisipan natin muli ang plano.

translations.EN: We're calling it off. Better safe than forcing it.
translations.TL: Ititigil muna natin. Mas mabuting ligtas kaysa pilitin.

translations.EN: Don't be discouraged, friend. We'll try again another day.
translations.TL: Huwag kang panghinaan ng loob, kaibigan. Susubukan natin ulit sa ibang araw.

translations.EN: I'd rather have you alive than whatever supplies are out there.
translations.TL: Mas gusto kitang buhay kaysa sa anumang gamit sa labas.

translations.EN: It's okay, partner. We made the right call to abort.
translations.TL: Ayos lang, kasama. Tama ang desisyon nating huminto.

translations.EN: Safety comes first. Come on, let's head back together.
translations.TL: Kaligtasan ang una sa lahat. Halika, sabay tayong bumalik.

translations.EN: Don't beat yourself up over this. We did what we could.
translations.TL: Huwag mong sisihin sarili mo. Ginawa natin ang makakaya.

translations.EN: We live to fight another day. That's the real victory, friend.
translations.TL: Mabubuhay tayo para lumaban muli. Iyon ang tunay na panalo, kaibigan.

translations.EN: Calling it off was smart. I'm glad you're safe beside me.
translations.TL: Matalinong desisyon ang huminto. Masaya akong ligtas ka sa tabi ko.

translations.EN: Take a breath. We'll rest up and plan better next time.
translations.TL: Huminga ka muna. Magpapahinga tayo at magpaplano nang mas maayos.

translations.EN: We'll get 'em next time, partner. Let's head inside.
translations.TL: Makakabawi tayo sa susunod, kasama. Pumasok na tayo.

translations.EN: Trip's off.
translations.TL: Kanselado ang biyahe.

translations.EN: Aborted.
translations.TL: Ihinto.

translations.EN: Scrubbed.
translations.TL: Kanselado.

translations.EN: Back inside.
translations.TL: Balik sa loob.

translations.EN: Cancel it.
translations.TL: Kanselahin.

translations.EN: Failed. Fall back.
translations.TL: Bigo. Umatras.

translations.EN: Not today.
translations.TL: Hindi ngayon.

translations.EN: Abort.
translations.TL: Tigil.

translations.EN: Off.
translations.TL: Wala na.

translations.EN: Regroup.
translations.TL: Magtipon ulit.

translations.EN: Excursion failed. We regroup here.
translations.TL: Bigo ang paglalakbay. Magtipon ulit tayo rito.

translations.EN: Something compromised the operation. Pull back immediately.
translations.TL: May sumira sa operasyon. Umatras agad-agad.

translations.EN: Forcing this run will get us slaughtered. Abort.
translations.TL: Kamatayan kapag pinilit ang lakad na 'to. Ihinto.

translations.EN: Fall back and figure out what went wrong behind closed doors.
translations.TL: Umatras at alamin kung anong pumalpak sa loob ng pinto.

translations.EN: The route is burned. We're retreating right now.
translations.TL: Nasira ang ruta. Aatras tayo ngayon din.

translations.EN: Trip canceled. Watch your back as we return to the gates.
translations.TL: Kanselado ang lakad. Bantayan ang likod habang bumabalik.

translations.EN: Bad intel or bad luck. Either way, we pull the plug.
translations.TL: Maling balita o malas. Alinman doon, itigil na.

translations.EN: Do not push forward into an ambush. Abort the mission.
translations.TL: Huwag lumusob sa tambang. Itigil ang misyon.

translations.EN: Abort. Secure the entrance and debrief.
translations.TL: Tigil. I-secure ang lagusan at mag-usap.

translations.EN: Failed attempt. Fall back and secure your weapons.
translations.TL: Bigong pagtatangka. Umatras at i-secure ang armas.
